task.title: Provide feedback about the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console
task.shortdesc: You can help Red Hat improve the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console by providing feedback about your experience. After you submit feedback, Red Hat product teams review the feedback and might contact you for further information.

ul.li: You are logged in to the Hybrid Cloud Console. You cannot log in to the Hybrid Cloud Console with your email address unless your email address is the same as your Red Hat login. For more information, see .

step.cmd: In the Hybrid Cloud ConsoleHybrid Cloud Console, click the Help button to open the help panel, then select the Feedback tab. Alternatively, you can click the Feedback button on the right side of the Hybrid Cloud Console window.

note.p: Not all pages in the Hybrid Cloud Console have the Feedback button.

step.cmd: Select the option for the type of feedback that you want to provide:

substep.cmd: To enter general feedback about your experience with the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console, click Share general feedback:

ol.li: Optionally, select the checkbox to stay informed about user research opportunities for the Hybrid Cloud Console. Your email address is added to the screen.

substep.cmd: To report a non-urgent issue, click Report a bug:

ol.li: Enter details about the issue you encountered. If your issue is urgent, click Open a support case to open the customer support page. For more information, see .
Optionally, select the checkbox to stay informed about user research opportunities for the Hybrid Cloud Console. Your email address is added to the screen.

substep.cmd: To stay informed about research opportunities for the Hybrid Cloud Console, click Inform the direction of Red Hat.

ol.li: Select the checkbox to learn about user research opportunities for the Hybrid Cloud Console. Your email address is added to the screen. Your email address is added to the screen.
